text: Expiry option values use Date.getTime(), which returns milliseconds. keyObj.expiryTime uses Unix seconds. RNP.changeKeyExpiration converts the chosen Date to seconds after the edited key was created. Radio value -1 means keep the date; 0 means no expiry. Preserve these distinct values when changing coercion, truthiness, names or defaults. In new or touched code, name time values for their real unit and state. The current local name expirySecs holds milliseconds, so it is a legacy inconsistency, not a naming example to copy. Scope: this expiry dialog and RNP boundary. Source checked; no expiry operation or automatic regression ran.
title: OpenPGP expiry crosses millisecond, Unix-second and key-relative-second boundaries
